name: windows-wpf-app
description: Create a WPF desktop application with MVVM pattern
request_pattern: Create a WPF desktop application in C# that ${app_purpose}. Use MVVM pattern with: ViewModels, data binding, ICommand implementation, INotifyPropertyChanged. Include a main window with ${ui_elements}. Add a settings page, proper error handling with user-friendly messages, and unit tests for ViewModels.

variables.app_purpose: manages a task list with categories and due dates
variables.ui_elements: navigation panel, data grid, detail view, status bar
